svg.text: A conformance claim is an attestation: required fields, the full dependency closure,

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and a recorded pass for every required command of every claimed class. The validator

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: refuses claims against non-claimable classes, unknown classes, and missing closure.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It does not execute the tests; anyone can independently rerun the commands a claim names.
